correctness.rationale: For n>=4, the known full toric semigroup lattice and 2n+1 truncated-cube facets give primitive rays (0,e_i),(1,-e_i),(-2,1,...,1). Their standard principal-divisor relations yield generators A_i,B and the single primitive relation sum A_i=2B, hence Cl at the Segre point is free of rank n. At each weight-two toric vertex the n incident coordinate normals give an integral basis of the saturated rank-n kernel a+c_i+c_j=0; the extra normal produces a free rank-one class group at the corresponding singular stratum. Other cones are smooth by the cited primary paper. The generator restrictions are A_k↦1_{k=i or j} and B↦1. The four-cycle equations are necessary and sufficient over integers by the t_i parity reconstruction in RESULT.md; the kernel is exactly the single stated relation. The coker is an image of the quadrilateral matrix and so free of rank binom(n,2)-n. A Python-standard-library checker in the package successfully enumerates finite examples 4<=n<=8 and tests matrix ranks, all facets, orbit rays and integer recovery; the proof is general and no finite sample is presented as exhaustive.

originality.rationale: The exact same-object primary paper of 2012 already determines the toric chart, facets, non-simplicial singular cones, singular components, and failure of Q-factoriality; all are treated as prior work. Standard toric class-group theory supplies the generic exact sequence. The new, narrower claim determines integral local class groups in all strata and, crucially, the localization image from their common Segre intersection as the saturated lattice of complete-graph quadrilateral-balanced labels. Source inspection and alias/equivalence searches did not identify that explicit compatibility result. This is an integral compatibility statement, not merely the old non-Q-factoriality result. There is residual risk of a classical unindexed toric computation and of considering the derivation routine from the already-known fan.
residual_risks: An unindexed source might have already carried out the same complete-graph restriction-lattice calculation on the 2012 secant fan.

The original 2012 paper supplies complete facet/ray data, so the new integral refinement is structurally dependent on it and may be judged an elementary consequence in a broader historical comparison.
No claim is made about class groups of completions, global Weil class groups, or characteristic other than zero.

value.rationale: The generic singular components of the binary Segre secant have independently rank-one Weil-divisor obstructions, yet at their common Segre locus those obstructions cannot vary freely. The theorem solves the natural compatibility/gluing problem exactly: the realizable integer defects are the complete-graph four-cycle-balanced labels; the map has rank n and saturated image of codimension binom(n,2)-n. The absence of torsion is a substantive integral statement invisible to Q-factoriality or to the mere count of singular components. It gives a complete local divisor-theoretic classification for every point of an infinite geometrically natural family, not an arbitrary small test or unsupported downstream application.
